locations.name: Sewer Entrance
locations.playerDescription: A rusted iron grate covers a dark passage leading down into the sewers. The stench is almost unbearable.
locations.gmNotes: This entrance is near the Artisans' Quarter. The grate can be lifted with a Challenging (-10) Strength test.

locations.name: Main Junction
locations.playerDescription: Several sewer tunnels converge at this junction. The sound of running water echoes from all directions. Strange markings are scratched into the walls.
locations.gmNotes: The markings are Skaven trail signs. A successful Very Hard (-30) Lore (Skaven) test reveals they mark safe passages.
hooks: A desperate man named Matthias waits here, claiming the Skaven took his daughter. He offers all his savings for her rescue.

locations.name: Rat Nest
locations.playerDescription: A foul chamber filled with debris and refuse. Countless rats scurry through the garbage, their eyes gleaming in the torchlight.
locations.gmNotes: This is home to a Giant Rat and its brood. Combat here risks attracting more vermin.

locations.name: Hidden Shrine
locations.playerDescription: Behind a false wall lies a small chamber with crude idols and offerings of rotting food. The air here feels... wrong.
locations.gmNotes: A secret shrine to the Horned Rat. The offerings suggest recent Skaven activity. There may be valuable clues here.
hooks: A tattered journal left here reveals the location of a Skaven arms cache in the Artisans' Quarter.

locations.name: Collapsed Tunnel
locations.playerDescription: The tunnel here has partially collapsed. Rubble blocks most of the passage, but a small opening might allow a nimble person to squeeze through.
locations.gmNotes: Squeezing through requires an Average (+20) Athletics or Contortionist test. On failure, take 1d10+2 damage from falling stones.

locations.name: Underground River
locations.playerDescription: The sewer opens into a natural cavern where an underground river flows. The water is dark and swift.
locations.gmNotes: Swimming the river is a Challenging (-10) Swim test. Failure means being swept downstream and taking 1d10 damage from impacts.
hooks: Strange glowing fungi grow on the far bank - valuable alchemical ingredients worth 50 GC to an apothecary.
